lines.en: Ken! Did you see the board? Our flight is delayed by two hours.
lines.pt: Ken! Você viu o painel? Nosso voo está atrasado duas horas.

lines.en: Oh no. **Could you** wait here while I talk to the airline desk?
lines.pt: Ah, não. Você poderia esperar aqui enquanto eu falo com o balcão da companhia?

lines.en: Sure. **What about** asking for a later hotel check-in, too? Eva is expecting us tonight.
lines.pt: Claro. Que tal pedir também um check-in mais tarde no hotel? A Eva está nos esperando hoje à noite.

lines.en: Good idea. **Would it be possible to** sit together on the new flight? I’ll ask.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Seria possível sentarmos juntos no novo voo? Vou perguntar.

lines.en: Good news! They gave us free snacks, and **I’d like to change** nothing else.
lines.pt: Boas notícias! Eles nos deram lanches de graça, e eu não quero mudar mais nada.

lines.en: Great. **I’ll take care of** the hotel message. Does the new flight land at six?
lines.pt: Ótimo. Eu cuido da mensagem para o hotel. O novo voo pousa às seis?

lines.en: Yes, at six instead of four. **To sum up:** two hours late, seats together, snacks.
lines.pt: Sim, às seis em vez de quatro. Resumindo: duas horas de atraso, assentos juntos, lanches.

lines.en: Perfect. **Let’s** text Eva now, so she isn’t worried.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Vamos mandar mensagem para a Eva agora, para ela não se preocupar.

pages.title: A2 Final Mission

situation.text: You and a friend are at the airport. Your flight is delayed, a friend is waiting for you at the destination, and you must talk to the airline, plan what to do and send a clear update. This is the final mission of A2.

pages.goal: By the end of the class you can meet, plan, ask for help, solve a travel problem and negotiate a solution in one connected conversation, with little support.
canDo: Understand the problem and explain it
Suggest and negotiate a plan with a partner
Ask staff politely for a solution
Summarize the new plan and inform someone
success: I ask politely for a solution.
I sum up and confirm the plan.
pages.think: What is the hardest part of solving a problem while traveling: understanding, asking, or staying calm?

pages.title: Cultural snapshot — Integrated mission: a trip with a problem to solve
pages.intro: Airports run on information: boards, announcements, desks and apps. Look and guess before you read.

cards.note: Flight information is shown on boards and apps, and staff can explain your options.
Giving your flight and time helps staff find a solution quickly.
A short message with the new time avoids worry.

qs.q: Where can you check flight information?
qs.pt: Onde você pode ver informações do voo?

levels.A2: On the board, on an app or at the airline desk.
levels.B1: Boards, apps and announcements show gates and times, and the desk can confirm details.
levels.B2: Airport screens, the airline app and desk staff are the usual sources, and they may differ, so it helps to confirm.

qs.q: What can you ask at the airline desk?
qs.pt: O que você pode perguntar no balcão da companhia?

levels.A2: Could you tell me my options? Would it be possible to change my flight?
levels.B1: You can ask about a new flight, seat changes or help with a hotel connection.
levels.B2: You can ask what options exist, and politely explain your constraints so the staff can propose a solution.

qs.q: Why is it useful to send a short update?
qs.pt: Por que é útil mandar uma atualização curta?

levels.A2: So the person waiting knows the new time.
levels.B1: A short message with the new arrival time avoids worry and lets others adjust.
levels.B2: A concise update lets others adapt their plans and shows consideration.

pages.compare: In Brazil, people often ask someone at the airport informally, and the answer depends on the person. In many English-speaking airports, polite, specific questions to the airline desk (“Could you tell me my options?”) are common. How do you ask for help when traveling?

teach.goal: Ativar o contexto cultural da missão: informação, pedido educado e atualização.
solo: Mostre os 3 cartões e peça hipóteses antes de explicar.
Peça que o estudante diga o que faria se o voo atrasasse.
group: Cada estudante escolhe um cartão e explica em uma frase.
Pergunte “Do you agree?” entre colegas.
answers: Q2: Could you tell me my options? / Would it be possible to…?
Q3: avisar o novo horário a quem espera.
extra: Have you ever had a delayed flight?
Who do you text when you are late?
support: Use as respostas do nível A1 como andaime e peça que repitam.
stretch: B2: explique como pedir uma solução quando o atraso já fez você perder uma conexão.

patterns.name: Asking staff
patterns.formula: **Could you** + verb? · **Would it be possible to** + verb?
ex: Could you tell me my options?
Would it be possible to sit together?
Could you check the next flight?

patterns.name: Suggest and take charge
patterns.formula: **What about** + noun/-ing? · **I’ll take care of** + noun
ex: I’ll take care of the hotel message.

patterns.name: Explain a problem
patterns.formula: **Our flight is** + adjective / **I’d like to change** + noun
ex: I’d like to change my seat.

patterns.name: Sum up
ex: To sum up, we land at six.
To sum up, seats together and free snacks.

head: Spoken English
Written English
rows: Could you tell me my options?
Could you please inform me of the available options?
We have been informed that our flight is delayed.
I will handle this and update you.
To sum up, we land at six.
In summary, our new arrival time is 6:00 p.m.
register.note: These are differences of context and register, not absolute rules.

teach.goal: Integrar os padrões principais do A2: pedir a funcionários, sugerir e resumir.
solo: Mostre o padrão DENTRO do diálogo (grife os chunks).
Use “Swap the words”: toque em cada peça e peça que o estudante diga a frase completa.
Compare spoken × written em 2 exemplos.
group: Troca em cadeia: cada estudante muda UMA peça e o próximo repete a frase.
Em pares: um escolhe as peças, o outro fala.
teach.answers: Padrão 01/02 são o foco; 03/04 são expansão para quem avançar rápido.
extra: Change one word and say the new sentence.
Which pattern is hardest under pressure?
support: Fique só com Could you… e What about… na primeira rodada.
stretch: Pedir uma solução e explicar a restrição: I have a connection at six, so would it be possible to…?

errors.w: Could you tell me where is the gate?
errors.r: Could you tell me where the gate is?
Would it be possible to sit?

pages.title: Pronunciation lab — natural American English
pages.tip: In English, one syllable in a word is stronger: AIRport, deLAYED, reserVAtion. Stress the right syllable and people understand you at once. The goal is to be clear, not to remove your accent.

own.prompt: Write three travel words you use often and mark the strong syllable.
own.criteria: Say each word twice. Could your partner hear the stressed syllable?

teach.goal: UM só fenômeno: acento de palavra (sílaba forte) em vocabulário de viagem.
solo: 3 passagens: escutar e identificar → reproduzir ritmo → usar em palavras próprias.
Peça que o estudante bata palmas na sílaba forte.
group: Coro, depois duplas; circule ouvindo.
Cada estudante diz 3 palavras de viagem com a sílaba forte marcada.
support: Reduza a velocidade e conte as batidas em voz alta.

Se acertar rápido, peça a versão mais informal ou mais formal.

Gap: delayed · What · Could you tell me my options, please? · I’d like to change my seat. · Yes, that works. Would it be possible…?

pages.title: Personalized roleplay — a delayed flight

brief.teacher: You are the airline desk agent (add a new problem each time!).
brief.student: Your flight is delayed. Explain it, ask for options, negotiate and summarize the new plan.

orders: A delayed flight and a friend waiting for you
A seat change for a trip with a friend
A missed connection and a hotel check-in problem
complications: The agent offers a flight a day later.
The airline can’t change your seats.
Your phone battery is low and you must write a short message.
success: I ask politely for a solution.
I sum up the new plan.

teach.goal: Simulação com complicação inesperada e três rodadas com menos apoio.
solo: Combine o cenário com uma viagem real ou imaginária do aluno.
Rodada 1: com chunks. Rodada 2: só palavras-chave. Rodada 3: sem roteiro.
Meta de fala: 60–70% do tempo para o estudante. Anote 2–3 correções para a devolutiva.
extra: What if there is no other flight today?
support: Volte à rodada 1 se travar; peça que repita só a primeira frase.
stretch: Negocie duas coisas ao mesmo tempo: o horário e um hotel.

errors.w: I need to go now, do something.
errors.r: Could you tell me my options? I need to arrive today, if possible.

rounds.title: Explain the problem
rounds.task: Your flight is delayed. Explain it to your partner and suggest a plan.
rounds.hint: Our flight is delayed. / What about…?

rounds.title: Ask staff
rounds.task: Ask the airline desk for options and a change.
rounds.hint: Could you tell me…? / Would it be possible to…?

rounds.title: Negotiate
rounds.task: The desk offers something you don’t like. Negotiate.
rounds.hint: I’d rather… / Is there another option?

rounds.title: Sum up

infogap.title: Flight options
infogap.instr: Ask your partner and complete your card. Do not look at the other card!

a.title: You are the passenger
a.task: You know your first flight. Ask the agent about the options.

b.title: You are the agent
b.task: You know the options. Ask the passenger about the flight.

teach.goal: Fluência por repetição de funções diferentes com informações novas a cada rodada.
group: Troque os pares a cada rodada (A+B / C+D → A+C / B+D → A+D / B+C → grupo todo). Com 6 estudantes, três duplas simultâneas.
Sem salas simultâneas: interações sequenciais enquanto uma dupla apresenta.
Responsabilidade individual: cada aluno faz ≥1 pedido, ≥1 sugestão e ≥1 resumo.
answers: Info gap: A tem o voo 218 às 14h; B tem opção 1 (voo 240, 18h15), opção 2 (voo 305, amanhã 8h) e hotel só na opção 2. Cada um completa perguntando.
extra: What time is the first option?
Is the hotel included?
support: Entregue frases-modelo no chat da turma.

pages.title: Group mission — the A2 trip
pages.goal: Each group completes a connected trip mission in English: meet and plan, ask for help, solve a problem, negotiate and sum up.

missions.mission: Your flight is delayed and you will miss a dinner. Plan with your partner, ask the agent for options and choose the best one.
missions.constraint: Use “What about…?”, “Could you tell me…?” and “To sum up…”.
missions.start: Our flight is delayed. What about…?

missions.mission: You arrive late at a hotel. Ask for a later check-in, a quiet room and a taxi, and agree on the extra cost.
missions.constraint: Use “Would it be possible to…?” and “I’d rather…”.
missions.start: Hello, we’re arriving late. Would it be possible to…?

missions.mission: A friend is waiting for you. Send a message with the new time, the reason and what you will do.
missions.constraint: Use “I’ll take care of…” and finish with a summary.
missions.start: Hi Eva! Quick update: our flight…

success: Sum up and confirm the plan.

teach.goal: Realizar algo com o inglês: missão integrada que usa o A2 inteiro com poucos apoios.
group: Cada grupo recebe papéis, restrição e missão. Alterne viajantes e atendente.
Progressão: 1ª rodada com frases de apoio, 2ª só palavras-chave, 3ª sem roteiro.
Observe e anote 2–3 correções prioritárias; devolutiva e celebração do A2 no fim.
answers: Modelo: “Our flight is delayed. What about asking the desk?” → “Could you tell me my options?” → “I’d rather leave tonight.” → “To sum up, flight 240 at 6:15 p.m.”
extra: What if the agent says no?
support: Dê o início de frase (“Start with”) em cada cartão.

pages.title: Writing — a small real-life task
pages.task: Write a short message to a friend who is waiting for you. Explain the delay, say what you asked the airline and give the new plan.
pages.model: Hi Eva! Quick update: **our flight is delayed** by two hours. **I asked** the desk **if it would be possible to** sit together, and they said yes. **To sum up:** we land at six, not four. **I’ll take care of** the hotel message. See you soon!
checklist: I greeted my friend and explained the problem.
I said what I asked for.
I used To sum up and closed politely.
pages.tip: Fix only 2–3 priority points. Show a more natural way to say the same idea instead of rewriting everything.

teach.goal: Produção escrita curta que integra explicar, pedir e resumir.
solo: Peça a mensagem; corrija 2–3 pontos prioritários e mostre uma forma mais natural.
group: Cada estudante escreve; depois troquem os textos entre colegas e corrijam em duplas.
extra: Add a plan B if the new flight changes again.
support: Dê o modelo e peça só para trocar os dados.

errors.w: We land at six, no at four.
errors.r: We land at six, not at four.

errors.w: I asked if it was possible sit.
errors.r: I asked if it would be possible to sit.

interpret.text: Needs more support. Revisit the main patterns with guided practice before the next lesson.
Functional performance. Work on the lowest criteria in the next lesson.
Good control. Raise complexity and speed; add follow-up questions.
Strong performance. Move to a more demanding situation.

prompts.improve: Example: Put the stress on the right syllable: deLAYED, inforMAtion.
prompts.next: Example: In B1, handle a longer problem and explain your reasons.

teach.goal: Avaliar o que o aluno conseguiu comunicar, não só os erros gramaticais. Use a rubrica para fechar o A2 e indicar o foco do B1.
solo: O estudante se autoavalia primeiro; depois você.
Feche com os três blocos: What you did well · What to improve · Your next challenge.
group: Dê um comentário por critério a cada estudante.
Cada um escolhe o próprio próximo desafio.
teach.answers: A rubrica é uma ferramenta interna de acompanhamento, não uma certificação CEFR.

unit: Plan · ask · solve · negotiate · sum up

teach.goal: Toda aula termina com uma produção observável. Feche o A2 com o que o aluno consegue fazer agora.
solo: Sem consultar as anotações: pedir informação, negociar e resumir.
group: Exit challenge individual; cada um diz uma coisa que conseguiu fazer hoje e uma meta para o B1.
answers: Could you tell me my options? · I’d rather leave tonight, if that’s possible. · To sum up, we leave at 6:15 and sit together.
extra: Revisão espaçada: retomar no início do B1 e depois de uma semana.

pages.title: Level up — the same situation from A1 to C2
pages.intro: The structure stays the same; language complexity and autonomy grow.

ladder.goal: Say it with short phrases and models.

ladder.say: Our flight is delayed. Could you tell me my options? What about a later flight?
Since the flight is delayed, we’d like to know whether there’s a later one that lands tonight, because a friend is waiting.
ladder.goal: Explain and compare options with connectors.

ladder.say: Given the delay, I was hoping you could rebook us on the earliest available flight and, if possible, arrange a hotel voucher.
ladder.goal: Negotiate with nuance and appropriate register.

ladder.say: I appreciate that these things happen, but I’d be grateful if you could find us a flight that gets us in tonight.
I fully understand the constraints you’re under; nonetheless, I’d welcome any arrangement that spares us an overnight stay.
ladder.goal: Manage the situation with precision and tact.

pages.note: This progression is illustrative: complex sentences do not define a level on their own. CEFR also considers comprehension, autonomy, fluency, accuracy, interaction and appropriateness.

teach.goal: Mostrar a progressão A1→C2 e apontar os próximos passos no B1.
solo: Mostre onde o estudante está e a próxima etapa.
group: Cada um escolhe a frase do próprio nível e a do próximo.
